The horror Palestinians endure every week is so relentless that it's hard to
document it all. As Palestinians marked [Nakba
Day](https://zeteo.com/p/the-1948-nakba-and-todays-gaza-genocide) yesterday,
this week was no exception.

The list below, for example, doesn't include that Israel's ultranationalist,[
noose-loving](https://zeteo.com/p/israel-ben-gvir-noose-birthday-cake-
palestinian-death-
penality?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share) national
security minister[ stormed the Al-Aqsa Mosque
compound](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/5/14/israels-ben-gvir-
storms-al-aqsa-during-jerusalem-day-march) and unfurled an Israeli flag on
Thursday. Nor does it include[ new data](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-
news/israel-security/2026-05-14/ty-article/.premium/israel-sharply-expands-
solitary-confinement-for-palestinian-inmates-data-
shows/0000019e-2517-d336-a9be-255762640000) that shows Israel has sharply
increased the use of solitary confinement for detained Palestinians. Nor the
story of a Palestinian child Israeli forces[ shot
dead](https://english.wafa.ps/Pages/Details/170463) just yesterday. (His name
was Fahd Zidan Owais. He was 16-years-old.)
